title: PerfTrace Engine
subtitle: C++ Workload Log Parser & Benchmarking Tool
description: A C++17 command-line tool that parses workload logs, runtime events, and failure records to analyze performance bottlenecks across repeated runs.
highlights: Core parser built with STL containers, file I/O, timestamp validation, error handling, and structured event aggregation for runtime, throughput, memory, and failure metrics
CMake build with gdb debugging, AddressSanitizer, Valgrind, and clang-tidy checks to catch memory errors and unsafe parsing patterns
Benchmark and regression test suite covering malformed logs, missing fields, duplicate events, invalid timestamps, and oversized records
